meta.title: Tiago Oliver — Frontend Engineer
meta.description: Frontend engineer based in Barcelona with six years of experience in React and TypeScript. Explore my work, read about my experience or get in touch.
meta.resumeDescription: Tiago Oliver's full CV: experience, projects, skills, education and how to get in touch.
language.label: Language
theme.label: Theme
about.paragraph1: I like working on the details of an interface: how it looks, how it behaves and how the code fits together. I care about making it easy to use and easy for another developer to work on.
about.paragraph2: Before becoming a developer in 2019, I managed a customer support team of twelve from 2013 to 2017. That taught me a lot about listening, setting priorities and explaining decisions clearly.
about.paragraph3: I'm also studying psychology at the UOC. Learning about attention and habits gives me another way to think about the interfaces I build. Spanish and Portuguese are my native languages, and I also speak English and Catalan.
contact.title: I'm open to remote frontend roles and freelance projects. Let's talk.
